introduction: After five years of war in Syria, Aleppo's remaining residents prepare themselves for a siege. Khalid, Subhi and Mahmoud, founding members of The White Helmets, have remained in the city to help their fellow citizens-and experience daily life, death, struggle and triumph in a city under fire.《阿勒波的最后一个人》（Last Men in Aleppo） 导演：菲拉斯·法耶德（Feras Fayyad）、斯蒂恩·约翰内森（Steen Johannessen） 丹麦入围2017年圣丹斯电影节曝首批片单世界纪录片单元
